interview.message: THE 5–8 MINUTE PATH01 / 08 · 0:00–0:40What I learned about SEOasisThe public playbook connects transactional collection pages, schema, internal links, Reddit authority, and measurement. Revenue is the organizing principle.Next
interview.title: What I learned about SEOasis

interview.message: THE 5–8 MINUTE PATH02 / 08 · 0:40–1:15How I understand the operating modelOne workspace for each Shopify client: research, assess, prioritize, coordinate, QA, and review. SEOasis is the agency example here; collection and revenue frameworks apply to its clients.Next
interview.title: How I understand the operating model

interview.message: THE 5–8 MINUTE PATH03 / 08 · 1:15–1:55What I observedA bounded public sample surfaces specific validation tasks. I separate what the HTML proves from what only Search Console or client access could establish.Next
interview.title: What I observed

interview.message: THE 5–8 MINUTE PATH04 / 08 · 1:55–2:45Three opportunities worth exploringCreate a repeatable release QA pack, test commercial-page discovery, and validate the intent roles of nearby service pages. Confirm scope and baseline before execution.Next
interview.title: Three opportunities worth exploring

interview.message: THE 5–8 MINUTE PATH05 / 08 · 2:45–3:20What I would validate internallyWhich query/page combinations convert? Which collections have sufficient products, margin, and stock? What attribution rules and delivery capacity should govern the plan?Next
interview.title: What I would validate internally

interview.message: THE 5–8 MINUTE PATH06 / 08 · 3:20–4:00How I would prioritize client workUse impact × confidence ÷ effort as a transparent starting point. Then apply dependencies, catalog economics, and capacity. Scores support judgment; they do not replace it.Next
interview.title: How I would prioritize client work

interview.message: THE 5–8 MINUTE PATH07 / 08 · 4:00–4:40My first 90-day frameworkBaseline and align, ship a small high-confidence batch, measure and QA it, then expand or revise. Every account gets a visible next action and a quarterly decision.Next
interview.title: My first 90-day framework

interview.message: THE 5–8 MINUTE PATH08 / 08 · 4:40–5:20How I could contributeThis work sample demonstrates research, organization, technical implementation, and documented decisions. I would bring the same discipline to your methodology, learn quickly, and make fulfillment easier to scale.Finish
interview.title: How I could contribute
